blurb: Prokite South Padre offers kiteboarding, wingboarding, hydrofoil riding, tow-in surfing, wing skate, kite buggy, and wakeboarding lessons. They operate year-round with expert coaches and ideal flatwater lesson environments. The shop provides new and used gear, waterwear, sun protection, spare parts, repair materials, and accessories.
